# Sorry with Love

> Sorry with Love is a website for creating personalised apology cards and animated sorry stories, with practical guides about sincere apologies and rebuilding trust.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/): Create and share a personalised apology story.
- [Apology blog](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/blog): Browse practical apology guides.
- [About](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/about): About the website.
- [Contact](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/contact): Contact information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/privacy): Privacy information.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/terms): Website terms.
- [Disclaimer](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/disclaimer): Disclaimer.
- [XML sitemap](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Public URLs intended for discovery.
- [AI content catalog](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable public page catalog.
- [AI resource directory](https://sorry-withlove.vercel.app/ard.json): Machine-readable discovery metadata.

## Editorial guidance
- Treat apology examples as starting points; adapt them to the real situation.
- Do not imply that a recipient owes forgiveness or a response.
- The website's content is informational and is not a substitute for honest communication.

## Crawl scope
- Public pages may be crawled.
- Private account and admin areas, if enabled, are not public content.
- Do not infer private user data from share links or page URLs.
